question: Should Twilio RCS ship as a bundled OpenClaw channel, or should the implementation be distributed as an external ClawHub plugin using the existing channel SDK?
rationale: The implementation already uses established plugin seams, while the repository policy favors keeping optional provider/channel capability outside bundled core. This is a product distribution and support decision that code review cannot safely infer.

options.title: Externalize to ClawHub
options.body: Move the Twilio-specific channel package out of bundled distribution and publish it as an independently installable plugin with its own setup and live RCS proof.

options.title: Sponsor bundled RCS
options.body: Explicitly accept the new bundled channel, configuration/support surface, exact-head dependency graph, and live carrier/device proof requirement before merging.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Leave the PR open until the linked feature discussion establishes a supported distribution direction.

recommendation.title: Externalize to ClawHub
recommendation.body: Move the Twilio-specific channel package out of bundled distribution and publish it as an independently installable plugin with its own setup and live RCS proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged SMS channel is the strongest current-main precedent for whether a phone-number transport should be bundled and supported with core.
